[major] Volta brackets that continue onto the next line break the unfolding

[minor] Pickup-bar acceptance is too permissive on single-staff scores

[major] Showcase step 4 stacks pitch labels from different systems onto one note (39 of 149 groups on the fixture)
[minor] A beamed tuplet inside a legitimately short bar (anacrusis or final bar) is dropped
[minor] Broken-tie continuation window (6 sp from staff.x1) does not clear a clef + key signature
[minor] Beam-tuplet candidates in one measure are applied all-or-nothing; no-time-signature numbers are applied unchecked
[minor] Showcase does not re-render on a devicePixelRatio-only change; small step-7 polish
[minor] Widened volta-continuation window swallows a bracketed tuplet (or any thin line) that starts the next line after an open last ending
[minor] Single-staff mid-piece short bars that are a whole number of beats are truncated, and the warning does not say so
[minor] Step-4 pitch labels that flip below their head land inside the staff over lines and stems
[minor] Synthetic-page polish: volta-2 line crosses the tuplet box, tied-continuation head has no marker, red barline colour ambiguous
[minor] Ottava (8va) lines are neither applied nor warned about, and can be absorbed as a volta continuation
[minor] Disclosed heuristic limits to keep on record (no fixture or probe impact)
